svg.title: RF spatial intelligence research program
svg.desc: A mobile research overview connecting sparse physical RF evidence, model-aware probabilistic inference, calibrated spatial beliefs, active measurement, and physical validation.

g.text: Sparse physical evidence becomes calibrated spatial belief,
then guides localization, motion, and the next measurement.
Partial geometry, receiver pose, and sparse multipath observations.
Score spatial hypotheses against physics, maps, and measured features.
Map, geometry, and RF feature fields
Preserve alternatives and uncertainty, then choose where to sense next.
Close the loop in measured systems; extend the same logic to adaptive wireless decisions.
Wireless/RF foundations - probabilistic spatial inference - autonomous systems
